facts.fact: General election day, 2026
facts.qualifier: Village of Pelham, Village of Pelham Manor and Town of Pelham races all appear on this ballot
facts.caution: NEVER say Pelham village elections are held in March — that has not been true since 2020. Village of Pelham, Village of Pelham Manor and Town of Pelham elections are all held in NOVEMBER. The Board of Education election is held in MAY. Pelham Manor moved from March to November after a 2024 voter referendum, first applying in 2025.

facts.fact: Village of Pelham FY2026-27 budget adoption vote
facts.qualifier: all five budget resolutions (A through E) passed April 28 2026. Voting yes: Deputy Mayor Carpenter, Trustees Anderson, Eldahry, Howell, Otondi and Solomon. Deputy Mayor Carpenter chaired.
facts.caution: There was NO 5-2 vote at any point in this process. Do not state otherwise. The tax cap override was a separate vote at an earlier meeting (January 13 2026), not part of the April 28 budget adoption.

facts.fact: Village of Pelham tax cap override, Local Law No. 1 of 2026
facts.qualifier: voted January 13 2026 at 8:57pm. Voting yes: Mayor Mullen, Deputy Mayor Carpenter, Trustees Anderson, Eldahry and Howell. State law requires 60% of total voting power; with seven board members 60% is 4.2, so five yes votes met the threshold despite two absences.
